clues: This town is a state city on the banks of the great river, in the west of its land. It lies a short way south of a more big river town.
This town sits in the south of a low plain on the great river. Folk count it one of the most warm towns of the whole land.
From 1949 to 1990 this town was the chief town of the west half of a split land. The whole state's rule sat here in those years.
One of the world's most famed song-smiths was born in this town. His tunes are still played in halls on all the Earth.
Twenty world-body posts sit in this town, more than in any town of its land. Two giant post and wire firms keep their head homes here too.
